title: Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant JSA Recruitment 2026
summary: Bihar Vidhan Sabha, Government of Bihar has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) posts. This recruitment is for 15 positions. The Bihar Vidhan Sabha application form has started on 07 November 2026, and candidates can apply until 06 December 2026. The minimum age is 18 Years & the maximum age is 37 – 40 years as on 01 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant JSA Recruitment 2026 provided below. ( Advt. No. 01/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate (Class 12th) examination in any subject from a board/council recognized by the State or Central Government, or an equivalent examination, by the last date of online application.
